policy.instruction: Do not delete or move anything while the user is unavailable. Record candidates only. If disk space becomes genuinely insufficient while the user is asleep, pause new high-write work and record the blocker; do not issue an approval prompt or delete silently.
policy.user_sleep_lock: Record cleanup candidates only; do not delete or move files and do not request cleanup approval while the user is asleep.
